scope: External prior art (arXiv, live-verified), Zenodo DOI resolution, external H1 dataset candidates, adjacent WBS domains, corpus data-quality findings.

arxiv_prior_art.title: Fast, Linear Time Hierarchical Clustering using the Baire Metric
arxiv_prior_art.note: The Baire metric induces an ultrametric on a dataset in linear time — an independent realization of the hierarchy-as-invariant thesis; relevant to H-DIST-2 (realization independence) and H-DIST-4 (toolbox).

arxiv_prior_art.title: Ultrametric Fitting by Gradient Descent
arxiv_prior_art.note: Fits ultrametrics to dissimilarity graphs; establishes the fitting/quantification baseline for the H1 compression-prior benchmark (H-DIST-3 null model).

arxiv_prior_art.title: A New Non-archimedean Metric on Persistent Homology
arxiv_prior_art.note: A cophenetic (non-Archimedean) metric on persistence classes; independent prior art for the cophenetic-distance lineage.

arxiv_prior_art.title: T-Stochastic Graphs
arxiv_prior_art.note: Statistical handling of the ultrametricity assumption in hierarchical network analysis; relevant to H-DIST-4 empirical ultrametricity testing.

arxiv_prior_art.title: Handling LP-Rounding for Hierarchical Clustering and Fitting Distances by Ultrametrics
arxiv_prior_art.authors: Hyung-Chan An, Mong-Jen Kao, Changyeol Lee, Mu-Ting Lee
arxiv_prior_art.note: Fitting ultrametrics under LP rounding; algorithmic prior art for the fitting problem.

arxiv_prior_art.title: Gromov-Hausdorff stability of linkage-based hierarchical clustering methods
arxiv_prior_art.note: Stability of hierarchical clustering under perturbations; grounding for the toolbox stability claims.

arxiv_prior_art.title: Temporal Hierarchical Clustering
arxiv_prior_art.authors: Tamal K. Dey, Alfred Rossi, Anastasios Sidiropoulos
arxiv_prior_art.note: Hierarchical clusterings of metric spaces over time.

arxiv_prior_art.title: Order preserving hierarchical agglomerative clustering
arxiv_prior_art.note: HAC over partial orders/DAGs — adjacent to the H-DIST-1 min-over-paths DAG question.

arxiv_prior_art.title: Toward ultrametric modeling of the epidemic spread
arxiv_prior_art.authors: V. T. Volov, A. P. Zubarev

arxiv_prior_art.title: Individual Fairness in Hierarchical Clustering
arxiv_prior_art.note: Published 2026-08-26 — same week; confirms the hierarchical-clustering/ultrametric-representation area is active; to be cited at P3/P4.

arxiv_prior_art.title: Hierarchical Clustering via Spreading Metrics
arxiv_prior_art.note: Hierarchies as first-class objects with explicit cost functions.

classical_prior_art_verified_by_citation: Sokal, R. R. & Rohlf, F. J. (1962). The comparison of dendrograms by objective methods. Taxon 11(2):33-40. — cophenetic correlation coefficient (the classical cophenetic-distance lineage).
Jardine, N. & Sibson, R. (1971). Mathematical Taxonomy. Wiley. — taxonomy-as-hierarchy canonical monograph.
Johnson, S. C. (1967). Hierarchical clustering schemes. Psychometrika 32(3):241-254.
Carlsson, G. & Memoli, F. (2010). Characterization, stability and convergence of hierarchical clustering methods. JMLR 11:1425-1470.
Bennett, C. H. (1979). Dissipation, information, computational complexity and the definition of organization. In Emergence (Pines, ed.) — early ultrametricity/emergence framing.
